### Brief Addon Description

Datixo is an API + frontend analytics addon that transfers order data from Shoptet to the Datixo platform for reporting and marketing attribution.

The addon connects orders with the visitor's original advertising source using attribution parameters such as UTM parameters, gclid and fbclid. This allows merchants to evaluate the performance of campaigns and individual advertisements in one dashboard without having to combine data manually from GA4, Google Ads, Meta and other systems.

The integration processes new and updated orders through Shoptet API and webhooks. A lightweight frontend measurement script is distributed through the Shoptet Addons Repository. The script does not add any visual or interactive elements to the storefront.

The addon was successfully installed and tested on the test project. The external settings redirect and initial data import are working after the fixes supplied by the partner.
